headline: Local Politician Uses 'Security Breach' Of A Stolen Lunchbox To Campaign For A Bulletproof Cabinet
body:
In a move that has left local ward office staff bewildered, a municipal councilor has officially declared the disappearance of his dabba from the staff lounge as a 'national security crisis' requiring an immediate procurement of a titanium-reinforced, explosive-resistant lunch locker. The councilor, who was seen checking the pantry’s CCTV footage four consecutive times during the morning session, claims the theft was a 'calculated tactical strike' against his policy-making abilities.

“If they can breach the security of my paneer butter masala, what is stopping them from infiltrating the entire municipal budget?” the councilor stated during a press briefing held specifically in front of his empty desk. He has already drafted a motion to the local municipal corporation requesting a dedicated 'Lunch Security Force' to escort his meals from his residence to the office to prevent further acts of culinary subversion.

Opposition leaders have mocked the request as a desperate attempt to inflate the councilor’s personal importance, suggesting that the lunchbox was likely misplaced by the councilor himself during his mid-morning nap. However, the councilor remains undeterred, stating that his lunch container holds 'sensitive intellectual data' in the form of his dietary notes and requires the same level of geopolitical scrutiny as any other major infrastructure project.
caption: When your office lunch becomes a matter of national security. #Politics #LunchBreach #Bureaucracy #Satire (satire)
